Game Overview

In Cool Tuning - Paint the Car, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your inner auto artist in "Cool Tuning: Paint the Car." Transform ordinary vehicles into extraordinary masterpieces with custom paint jobs, films, and stickers. Craft your vision, then sell your creations at auction to become a renowned car designer. Dive into the vibrant world of car customization!
